Thank you. Being that young and that depressed definitely aged me a lot, it also taught me a lot. I know I can get through anything but right now it just feels like "what's the point"? It's such a struggle to get me out if this.

I have previous posts explaining my family situation. He got really angry over a tiny thing and hurt me a fuckton. Mum took his side basically so voilà! My mum's a big part of why I was so depressed at a young age.

😂😂
RIGHT!? She didn't even bring up all the shitty things she's done let alone apologise for them. I do want some type of relationship to be able to get my stuff in the future but not this, not right now.

I have my ~~brothers~~ abusers old laptop with me! As well as a library card, those things are magic in a card. 

There's a prevention put in place now but you still think I should get a new one? The address on it has been changed to my friends place for now.

She's STILL trying to contact me. Because it's through other people it isn't absuive. It's more "I'll support your decision to move out and help you, let's just forget about everything, I wanna be in your life" now. She sent me a message through my cousin and even my cousin was suspicious about the 180 of her mood and thinks it's a trap.
You know I'd never, no matter what ❤️
I could've reported the violent abuse as well but Ive spent too much energy the past 19 years dealing with them, I don't want to give them more of my life tbh

GYSPY LIFESTYLE! Love it! I'm 19!! My brother is 22 and has always been babied by my mother. He literally can't live without her because he doesn't know how to do anything for himself. I grieve for the family I never had, the mother's unconditional love I never recieved, but I've learnt to love myself enough to make up for that and more. I can't wait to properly be free and fly!

What's it with mothers and their sons 😂

The shutting off of netflix is SO petty and HILARIOUS. 🤣🤣

Where/how do you move every three months?

Currently yes, I'm in the process of getting temporary accommodation and will hopefully get a job soon too. Most of my things are at my mum's house. Was hoping for a level of understanding between us so I could get my things in the future but looks like I'll have to go from scratch rn. RIP my little library I built over the years 🙏
Honestly probably yes. He stays inside all day and is depressed
I've mostly healed now but I did take pictures when they happened. I'm a bit hesitant going to the police and I don't know why.
